title: linum angustifolium subsp. humile
intro: Linum angustifolium subsp. humile, commonly known as narrow-leaved flax, is a plant species within the Linaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of narrow-leaved flax include its ability to protect against cell damage, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable natural remedy. The bioactive constituents of Linum angustifolium subsp. humile include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
